title: fix(metadata-protocol, service-automation): a declared .custom flow override is armed from the first boot pull (#28717)
body:
domain:server#1 · os-project-manager · session_01R1q2xdtYgU6FKrZ7LgjPCC

Fixes #28717

Clause-②: yes (widening: the new public export shadowedStoredRowsOf from @objectstack/metadata-protocol; no accept-set change)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：同一个基础包流程名下，如果既有旧的无包存储行，又有 `BASE.custom` 里声明的覆盖，注册表那唯一的裸槽位现在固定留给覆盖，不再看数据库读取顺序。启动拉取从第一次起就挂上覆盖。旧行原样留在库里、不挂载，启动的遮蔽告警会点名它和胜出的覆盖。
- **为什么改**：以前谁最后被读到谁占槽位。旧行排在后面时，启动拉取看不到覆盖，挂的是基础流程；`kernel:ready` 之前触发的记录变更跑的是基础流程，而且没有任何报错。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只在一个名字同时有声明覆盖和别的存储行时生效；判定只用存储的 `package_id` 列加 `isServedOverrideRowOf`，不看正文 `_packageId`。只有一行时行为不变。不删行、不迁移、不改 spec。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/stored-flow-slot.ts`（槽位规则与被挤出行的携带）；`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` 的 `hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry`（紧挨 `bindStoredRow` 的调用点）；`packages/services/service-automation/src/plugin.ts` 的启动拉取（把被挤出的行列为竞争者）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/flow-declared-override-first-boot-pull.integration.test.ts`，预期 6/6 通过（两种入库顺序下 `kernel:ready` 前的记录变更都跑覆盖、告警点名旧行，加两个对照）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**First commit: three comment corrections from the #28412 landing (prose only).** The `stored-row-binding.ts` header and `hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry`'s `[#23233]` header follow #28673's column-wins `withRowBinding`: a body's own `_packageId` is replaced by the column or dropped, and view-container expansions register from the stamped row. The receipt-intent comment in `deleteMetaItem` now says the pair-row removal is `flow` only. `git diff origin/main...HEAD` is this card's work only, starting with that commit.

**The bare-slot order (Wanted 1).** The SchemaRegistry holds one bare slot per flow name. `hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry` registered every stored row of a name into it, so the last row the store read won. Now, right beside `bindStoredRow`, the hydration asks `incomingTakesStoredFlowSlot(held, incoming, owner)` (new, `stored-flow-slot.ts`). The shipping package's declared override keeps the slot over any other stored row of the name, in either read order. It is judged by the one served-override predicate, `isServedOverrideRowOf`, on the row's stored binding (`storedRowBindingOf`, the `package_id` column #28412 records), never on a body's `_packageId`. The same row read again (same binding) always replaces itself, so a re-save of the override, declared or not, is what the slot holds. Every other pair of stored rows keeps "the last row read wins". The rule lives in the hydration because the boot pull reads the registry, not the store, and the hydration is where the slot is filled: `loadMetaFromDb` at boot, the list read's hydration and the write-through all go through it.

**The legacy row: left in place and shadowed (Wanted 2).** The row that loses the slot is not deleted or migrated (`flow` has `allowEnvironmentOverlay: false`, and the declared flow write door is #28412's). It stays stored and unarmed. So that the boot names it, the hydration carries it on the override's registry body under a non-enumerable symbol (`shadowedStoredRowsOf`, newly exported), with its own stored binding still recorded. The boot pull lists it beside the override, so the existing precedence ranks it `runtime`: it is shadowed, recorded in the engine's shadowing receipt, and named in the existing collision warning, the one whose remedy #28412 rewrote. The warning reads: "Flow name collision: 'NAME' is claimed by 3 definitions (the declared override in 'BASE.custom' (sys_metadata), package 'BASE', a runtime-authored row (sys_metadata)); arming the declared override in 'BASE.custom' (sys_metadata) because it is the declared override of 'BASE' (ADR-0146 D9), and shadowing 2 other definition(s)…". No new predicate, no new rank and no new warning.

⛔ No `packages/spec/**`, no new gate and no new error code.

**Clause-② measured: yes (widening).** The widening is the one new public export, `shadowedStoredRowsOf` from `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (read by the automation boot pull). No key, value or write is admitted or refused differently. The diff changes which stored body the registry's bare slot holds at hydration, and what the boot pull lists from it. The declared override was already admitted by the #28412 accept-set, and this arms it earlier in the same boot. **Metadata-protocol measured: none.** Nothing a metadata author can write changes.

## Tests

<details><summary>New cases, and red first on main</summary>

- `service-automation` `flow-declared-override-first-boot-pull.integration.test.ts` (new). It uses a real ObjectKernel, ObjectQLPlugin's metadata protocol over driver-sql on a better-sqlite3 FILE, the shipping package registered through the `manifest` service, and the real automation plugin. It boots twice on one file: the first boot stores the rows, the second, cold boot is measured. A record change is fired from a plugin `start()` after the automation plugin's, so after the boot pull and before `kernel:ready`. Both row orders are covered:
  - each order: the record change fired before `kernel:ready` runs the override, and no step arms the legacy body;
  - each order: the boot pull's receipt and warning name the legacy row and the override that wins;
  - control: the legacy row alone is shadowed by the base and warned, as before;
  - control: the override alone is armed silently (#28412).
- `metadata-protocol` `stored-flow-slot.test.ts` (new, 8 cases). Override held over a legacy row, or legacy displaced by the override (each carried once). The same row read again. A package-less row stamping the pair loses (binding, not stamp). No override: last read wins. Empty slot, loader entry, or no owner settle nothing. Nothing is serialized.

Red first: the production sources (`protocol.ts`, `index.ts`, `plugin.ts`) were restored to main `3ee6af44`, `metadata-protocol` was rebuilt, and `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` exited 0. Result: `Tests 3 failed | 3 passed (6)`:
- `× rows stored override then legacy > a record change fired before kernel:ready runs the override's body` (`expected 'BASE' to be 'OVERRIDE'`);
- `× rows stored override then legacy > the boot pull names the shadowed legacy row and the override that wins`;
- `× rows stored legacy then override > the boot pull names…` (`expected [] to deeply equal [ Array(1) ]`: the override was armed, but nothing named the legacy row).

The three green on main are the legacy-then-override arming case and the two controls. Restore: `git checkout HEAD --`, each blob equal to HEAD, porcelain empty, rebuilt, marker present again.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: the bare-slot order put back</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `if (!incomingTakesStoredFlowSlot(held, registered, owner)) return true;` with a call that ignores the verdict, so the last row read takes the slot again. The anchor was present in the pristine dist (2 files) and absent from the mutated build (preflight `--absent` exit 0). Result: `Tests 2 failed | 4 passed (6)`, with `× rows stored override then legacy > a record change fired before kernel:ready runs the override's body` (`expected 'BASE' to be 'OVERRIDE'`) and the matching warning case red. Restore: `ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD … git diff HEAD is empty`, rebuilt, the mutation marker absent from dist (exit 0), porcelain empty.
</details>

<details><summary>Full suites, typecheck, lint, gates</summary>

All on head `7d00bb37`:

- `metadata-protocol` full suite, under the verify lock: `Test Files 295 passed | 4 skipped (299)`, `Tests 22030 passed | 26 skipped (22056)`.
- `service-automation` full suite, under the verify lock: `Test Files 252 passed (252)`, `Tests 3239 passed (3239)`.
- `tsc --noEmit -p .`: exit 0 for `metadata-protocol` and `service-automation`. Both configs include the new test files (`--listFiles`).
- `eslint --no-inline-config packages/metadata-protocol packages/services/service-automation`: exit 0.
- Derived gate list (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, 63 families): each was run with its exit code captured before any pipe, and all exited 0. `--ran`: `63 derived, 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. `check-nul-bytes`: exit 0.
- Dogfood battery: not owed (no `!` in the title, and no `(narrowing)` arm).
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The boot's sealed-overlay report still counts the declared override.** `[metadata_sealed_overlay_unserved]` at boot lists the `.custom` override row with the legacy row ("flow×2 … No read serves them — the package's own definition is served … re-express it as a new item under a new name"). Since #28412 the override is served and armed, so that line is wrong about it. This is outside this card; the report records it as a finding for the seat.
- **Only the boot pull reads the carried rows.** The protocol's view (`kernel:ready`, `metadata:reloaded`, the mutation sync) serves one item per shipped name and arms the override from the store, as before. The carried rows exist only on the registry body.
- **A runtime delete of the legacy row** was not measured here. The by-name registry eviction a delete may cause could address the bare slot, which now holds the override, until the next hydration. This is an unmeasured reading, recorded only here.
